evaluation.safety: Standard crosswalks, traffic signs, low residential traffic speed, high safety.
evaluation.livability: Surrounded by mature residential areas, dense greenery, superior living atmosphere.
evaluation.sustainability: Mature avenue trees and layered green belts, excellent ecological regulation.
evaluation.aesthetics: Symmetrical lush tree corridor, clean and tidy road surface, elegant urban residential street view.

evaluation.bikeability: Independent non-motor lane, safe and comfortable daily cycling.
